## Report
```{r, include=FALSE}

data <- read.csv(params$csv_file)

algorithms <- unique(data[["Sorting.algorithm"]])
distributions <- unique(data[["Distribution"]])
max_sample <- max(data[["Sample.size.for.mean"]])
min_input <- min(data[["Input.size..n."]])
max_input <- max(data[["Input.size..n."]])

```

#### **Algorithms tested**: `r algorithms`
#### **Distributions**: `r distributions`
#### **Sample size for one trimmed mean**: `r max_sample`
#### **Input range**: `r min_input` - `r max_input`

```{r, echo=FALSE}

plot_algorithm <- function(data, algorithm, x_lim = NULL, y_lim = NULL) {
  filtered_data <- data[
    data[["Sorting.algorithm"]] == algorithm,
  ]
  
  if (nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste("Algorithm not found:", algorithm))
  }
  
  # If no x_lim given calculates the common x-axis range
  if (is.null(x_lim)) {
    x_lim <- range(
      filtered_data[["Input.size..n."]],
      finite = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  # If no y_lim given calculates the common y-axis range
  if (is.null(y_lim)) {
    y_lim <- range(
      filtered_data[["Mean.runtime..ns."]],
      finite = TRUE
    )
  }

  for (i in seq_along(distributions)) {
    plot_data <- filtered_data[
      filtered_data[["Distribution"]] == distributions[i],
    ]

    if (i == 1) {
      plot(
        plot_data[["Input.size..n."]],
        plot_data[["Mean.runtime..ns."]],
        type = "b",
        xlim = x_lim,
        ylim = y_lim,
        col = i,
        pch = 16,
        xlab = "Input size",
        ylab = "Execution Time (ns)",
        main = paste(algorithm, "by input distribution")
      )
    } else {
      lines(
        plot_data[["Input.size..n."]],
        plot_data[["Mean.runtime..ns."]],
        type = "b",
        col = i,
        pch = 16
      )
    }
  }

  legend(
    "topleft",
    legend = distributions,
    col = seq_along(distributions),
    pch = 16,
    lty = 1,
    title = "Distributions"
  )
}
```

---

## **Algorithm runtimes**  


```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

for (i in seq_along(algorithms)) {
  plot_algorithm(data = data, algorithm = algorithms[i])
  cat("\n\n\n")
}

```
